blocks.text: The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: Let him do whatever he wants! Edoardo is responsible.
exercises.ru: Дайте ему делать ___, что он хочет! Эдоардо ответственный.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Flatterers look like friends, as wolves like dogs.
exercises.ru: Льстецы похожи на людей ___ же, как волки на собак.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I think it's time for me to reconsider how I've been living.
exercises.ru: Думаю, настало время переосмыслить ___, как я живу.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I didn't even try to get into what he said.
exercises.ru: Я даже не пытался вникнуть в ___, что он говорил.

exercises.q: Do you believe what you say?

exercises.q: An electric guitar sounds different to an acoustic one.
